exposure: Net change in glycosylated haemoglobin (HbA1c) from early to late pregnancy
finding: Women with pregestational diabetes who experienced a reduction in HbA1c from early to late pregnancy had a lower risk of delivering LGA infants and infants with neonatal hypoglycaemia.
gest_age: Early pregnancy: 9 weeks (IQR 7,13), Late pregnancy: 31 weeks (IQR 29,34)
